definitions.explanation: Woven or felted material used for making clothes or other items.

examples.japanese: {布|ぬの}を{買|か}って{カーテン|かーてん}を{作|つく}った。
examples.english: I bought fabric and made curtains.

examples.japanese: この{布|ぬの}は{柔|やわ}らかい。

notes: General term for fabric. Related: {布団|ふとん} (futon), {雑巾|ぞうきん} (cleaning rag).
